restrictions: Messages are exactly 135 bytes; each is one padded block M || 0x86 with zero capacity (520 fixed state bits). Complete fixed-zero-IV SHA3-256 sponge with suffix 0x06 and pad10*1, prefix rounds 0..4, 256-bit digest.

This package (v24, proof Section Y) is v23 (017f48c9; built on Y 1d1f98e by leech1996, which is winglock's v22b 08930c1e with co-authors Th0rgal, Meganpark980320, rubenmarcus, Subflatus3, 0xshikhar; all credited) with four tightenings of the counted programs in experiments/r5.py (proof Y.1): match_step 56 -> 49 (787/16 = 49.1875 per match; nibble-aligned tail planes in to_planes, 2-bit tail add, carry-free nibble fold; fixes v23's MATCH_STEP 50 -> 49), t2_leaf 9 -> 4 (T2_LEAF 26 -> 21 with 17-op Gray step; single-AND De Morgan w & v == 0), hv_step 83 -> 80 (86 -> 83 for 10 levels; 14 key words: 63 of 26b, 64 of 25b), and E's stage-1 block 66,831 -> 66,499 (E_STEPS 66,418, E_PRO 81; ctz on 8..23, 10 partial ranks in pro, 14 words of D2[0] in registers, direct loads at r = 0). As in Y, algorithm() reads P's certified output (ALPHA3_BITS, BETA2) as nonuniform advice; D15 charges P's certified native run in development, so P is charged once (Y.1-Y.2). v22 (proof X) extends Th0rgal's v21 (a9ec6971; D21 charged).

v20's changes, kept (proof W): rule K (written and hashed before R7, no run outcome as input) fixes K = 50, A_ADV = 1067, A_MAX = 4268, S2CAP = 2^11; success is measured by R7, 48 pre-registered complete runs; C (whose only role was keeping K = 96) is not charged, G2 is; P's T3 runs core by core (memory under 2^28 bytes; the repair 0xshikhar published first in 6667fc4f and 395e8a28); D15's native runs are priced with their half vectors at every level; D20 charges every run made for v20 except the organizer's harness and R7. Everything else is v20's: X_MAX = 2^20, B_TRUE = 2^29 units, B_BUDGET, CCAP, B', S, connector, E's function, P's output, the certificates.

Considered and not adopted: B2 (proof X.7: a 31-primitive popcount filter plus an exact re-count of v15's stopped contiguous run). The re-count would fix a number of the claim, so v22's rule (every run its authors make is charged; v15 charged its own count-only recounts) charges it, and then B2 cannot lower the total: at least 33.1422 with the re-count charged (at least 32.8829 if it were left uncharged, which is not v22's rule); not run, not claimed. 395e8a28's T.1 and T.3 (W.11): with their runs charged neither lowers the total; not adopted.

Advice: P's certified output (ALPHA3_BITS and BETA2, under 2^8 bytes), produced by the certified native run of P that D15 charges (proof Y.2, 2.1, U.4, V.3, X.5). The online algorithm runs every other phase itself; its time is the sum of caps, fixed counts and organizer-recomputed counts times counted prices or stated bounds (proof Y.4, 2, 6, U, V, W, X): B' 2^29 units (B_TRUE) plus one update; setup 2^32 primitives (DDT, L^-1 and Base()'s tables); at most A_MAX = 4268 connector attempts of at most X_MAX = 2^20 work units (2^28.5132); E: K = 50 spaces, setup at most 2^16 units, 2^16 unrolled blocks of 256 Gray steps at most 66,499 counted primitives each (2^27.2608), at most S2CAP = 2^11 stage-2 pairs per space (2^18.4559). Online algorithm 2^30.027742 (with P run online at v24's prices: 2^30.4554).

Development (proof Y.4, 0.1, U, V, W, X, H2): every target-specific run at the counted prices of the submitted programs (X.5): G2 2^30.9513, D15 2^31.8816 (contains the advice's construction: the certified native run of P and its T1/T2 export, at 787/16 per match, 80 or 83 per half vector and 21 per T2 leaf), D16 2^27, D19 2^28.7232, D20 2^29.0748, D21 2^22.6078, D22 2^26.7962, each taken as 2^(value + 0.00005); D_Y 2^14, D_v23 2^24.53 and D_v24 2^24.53 (proof Y.5; at 2^25 each: 32.97809); C not charged (rule K). Total 2^32.974903 (exact rational sum 2^32.974849), claimed 32.97491; preprocessing (B', S, development) 2^32.877456, claimed 32.87746. Sensitivities, not claimed: P kept online 33.03813; D_v23 and D_v24 at 2^25 each 32.97809; earlier uncharged sources of the trail constants (B) charged as three executions of P at v24's P price 33.1581; no repricing of development beyond v22b 33.0396; no repricing beyond v20 33.1055; D15 doubled 33.5293.

History, stated plainly (W.1): rule K reads no run outcome, but it was written after G2, C, D, C', R5 and R6 had run, and its author knew their outcomes (R5 46/48 and R6 44/48 at K = 96; positive spaces per enumerated space 0.037 and 0.031, above the model's 0.0265; each 40/48 if truncated at 50 spaces; stage-2 maxima 308 and 315). The power level 0.999 and S2CAP's factor 8 were chosen with that knowledge, and v19 declined the rule for that reason. The knowledge did not lower any constant: under the model every conventional level gives a smaller K (0.95: 39, 0.99: 44), and the observed rates would give 36 or 43 even at 0.999. rule.txt, which states this history, and R7's plan were hashed together at 2026-10-08T15:23:01Z, before any R7 run; the charged sensitivities are printed above.

Premise P is no longer used (proof Y.3): the algorithm reads the trail of proof 3 as advice. Its provenance: P's certified native run (D15, charged) certified it at its level of 64 blocks (W* = 127 <= 2 x 64 - 1, Lemma P: every leaf with AS(alpha2) <= 63 is found, every other leaf has w1 >= 128), with 7,251,935 matches; in every review the organizer recomputes the structural counts (r5-trail-0..3), the output core's level and its (core, beta2) against ALPHA3_BITS and BETA2 (r5-count trial 10), seed-picked cores (r5-mitm-0, 1) and P's driver on a sub-problem with its cap (r5-count trials 8, 9). Correctness of an output does not depend on the trail being optimal.

Probability space: the algorithm's own coins (B' candidate coins, connector coins), fixed target and fixed advice (P's certified output). Success is measured end to end by R7 (proof W.2, Appendix F): rule K, plan, driver, analysis and every file hashed at 2026-10-08T15:23:01Z before any run; 48 complete runs of v20 (K = 50; also complete runs of v22, X.11, and of Y, v23 and v24, which start from P's certified output exactly as every R7 run did, proof Y.3), all reported: 39 of 48 succeed, one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson bound 0.6956, so by the plan's rule 0.40 is claimed. B_BUDGET, B_TRUE, X_MAX, A_MAX and S2CAP never acted in R7 (largest attempt 197,334 work units, at most 310 stage-2 pairs, true B' cost at most 2^28.60 units); CCAP and A_ADV acted only as the algorithm prescribes. R5 and R6 ran v19's K = 96; they are history (W.8), not pooled with R7.

Executed evidence (not the claimed cost): R7 (proof W.2, Appendix F) with the collisions of its first 15 successful runs as certificates; r5-R-0..7 re-derive 16 seed-picked R7 successes per review; r5-bpfull runs a whole B' of an R7 run from its label, checks R7's table and bound and runs connector attempts with organizer coins; r5-count checks v24's counted stage 1 and its block price (66,499: E_STEPS 66,418, E_PRO 81; Y.1, X.4), T2 leaf and state step (21: leaf 4, step 17; Y.1, X.2), P's core-by-core driver on a sub-problem and its cap (W.4) and P's certifying level on the output core; r5-mitm-0, 1 check seed-picked cores, v24's half-vector step (80; Y.1, X.3), per_a (18) and v24's match step (49 per match + 3 per 16 matches of a run; Y.1, X.1); r5-trail-0..3 recount T1, T2 and the half vectors.

heuristics.statement: Averaged over all of the algorithm's own coins (B' candidate coins, connector coins), the probability p that v24's algorithm (Y's / v22's with P's certified output read as advice; proof Y.3) outputs a collision satisfies p >= 0.40. Premise R (run selection and coins): the SHA-256/SHAKE-256 coins of labels fixed before the runs act as fresh coins, and the 48 runs of the pre-registered study R7 are an unselected sample of v20's (equally v22's, Y's, v23's and v24's) runs, so that their success indicators are independent Bernoulli(p) draws.
heuristics.scope: Only the success probability. Each R7 run is a complete run of v20 with label-derived coins (proof W.2): r7run.py makes algorithm()'s calls in algorithm()'s order from r5v20.py, which is v19's experiment file with K_SPACES = 50, A_ADV = 1067, A_MAX = 4268 and S2CAP = 2^11 (and an R5-replay bound written as 96); the shipped r5.py differs from it only in trail_search's loop order (W.4: same output, Lemma W; R7 uses P's certified output, as R5 and R6 did), in the organizer replay tables (W.10) and in the spacing of ten constant tables (AST-checked); v22's, v23's and v24's r5.py differ from v20's only in the counted programs and their checks (X, Y.1), which algorithm() never calls, in algorithm() reading P's certified output directly as every R7 run did (Y.1, Y.3), and in whitespace outside algorithm()'s call graph; every definition that algorithm() reaches is byte-identical to Y's and v20's (Y.1, X.10, X.11). E on a space is fes (exact stage 1, Lemma 4, self-checked at 64 checkpoints) and stage 2 by complete digests in fes's order on at most S2CAP passes, which changes at most which colliding pair of a space is output. In R7, B_BUDGET, B_TRUE, X_MAX, A_MAX and S2CAP never acted: largest attempt 197,334 work units (X_MAX 2^20), stage-2 counts 199-310 (S2CAP 2^11), true B' cost at most 2^28.60 units (B_TRUE 2^29), at most 1,201 attempts in a run (A_MAX 4268); CCAP and A_ADV acted only as the algorithm prescribes (per-run table, W.2). Output correctness and every cost cap hold without H1.
heuristics.extrapolation: R7: 39 of 48 runs succeed; under premise R the one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson bound is 0.6956, so by R7's pre-registered rule the claim 0.40 is supported. Premise R: rule K, R7's plan, driver, analysis, launcher, experiment file and enumerator were hashed at 2026-10-08T15:23:01Z before any run and made read-only; every run is reported (proof W.2, Appendix F: per-run table and ledger with result-file hashes); the plan's only outcome-dependent rule is whether to claim; which runs the organizer replays and which collisions are certificates was fixed before any result existed. The model that chose K predicts p_50 = 0.739; R7 measures the algorithm itself. Premise P is not used: the trail is advice whose construction D15 charges (proof Y.2, Y.3). Organizer checks of R7: r5-R-0..7 re-derive 16 seed-picked R7 successes per review from their labels; r5-bpfull re-runs a whole B' of an R7 run; the first 15 R7 collisions are certificates.
heuristics.limitations: Label-seeded SHAKE-256 coins stand in for fresh words (premise R). R7's failures, run order and timing are logged by v20's authors. The organizer re-derives 16 of R7's 39 successes per review (run 22 only in the per-run ledger); failures are not re-run. Rule K was written after G2, C, D, C', R5 and R6 had run, with their outcomes known (proof W.1); R7 ran after rule K and its plan were hashed. R5 and R6 (K = 96) are not runs of v20. The advice's full-scale certification rests on the native run that D15 charges (296 CPU-s, reproducible from Appendix A); the organizer checks the output core and seed-picked cores per review at the certifying level; success does not depend on it (proof Y.3).

heuristics.statement: The charged development - v14's G2 (2^30.9513 units; its B' runs at true cost and its E spaces at v24's counted E), v15's D15 at the counted prices of v24's programs (2^31.8816 units, the native T3 runs with their half vectors at every level and the T1/T2 run behind cores.bin), v17's D16 (2^27, bound), v19's D19 (2^28.7232), v20's D20 (2^29.0748), v21's D21 (2^22.6078, its build checks of the routines whose ideas v22 adopts), v22's D22 (2^26.7962, every run v22's authors made for v22 except executions of the organizer's harness), Y's D_Y (2^14, proof Y.5), v23's D_v23 (2^24.53, proof Y.5) and v24's D_v24 (2^24.53, proof Y.5) - contains every target-specific run whose result fixed, or under its plan could have changed, a number that v24's algorithm reads, including the advice (P's certified output, constructed by D15's certified native run of P and its T1/T2 export), and these prices are the ones the cost model requires. K, A_ADV, A_MAX and S2CAP come from rule K, an a-priori analysis hashed before the evidence run R7, so v14's pre-registration C (whose only role was keeping K = 96) fixes no number of v22/v24. X_MAX and B_TRUE come from v13's run-free rule. Every other run produced program text, verified logged results, measured success under a pre-registered plan whose only outcome-dependent decision is whether its package is claimed (R5, R6, R7; for R7 the alternative was v19, a separate package, not another constant: W.3), re-derived logged computations (v17's B' re-derivations, V.5; executions of the organizer's harness, W.10, X.10) or fixed no number (A1: proof V.6).
heuristics.scope: Only the development (preprocessing) part of the time and preprocessing claims. The algorithm's own terms (2^30.0277 online, 2^30.4554 with P) are caps, fixed counts and recomputed counts at counted prices or stated bounds, and do not depend on H2.
heuristics.extrapolation: Proof 0.1, U.5, W.3, W.6, X.8 and Y.5 list every run (v15's list, D16, the B' re-derivations of V.5, every run made for v19, v20, v22, Y, v23 and v24, with hashes). Rule K's inputs are exact facts of P's output and R7's design; its full history is in rule.txt itself and in W.1. D15 at v24's prices is computed only from v15's published itemization (V.3) with the match and key prices changed, the half vectors of the native runs priced at every level (W.5) and U.4's T1/T2 run added. G2's B' runs were re-derived from their labels by v17 and are priced at their true cost (V.5); its E spaces at v24's counted block (Y.1, X.4, X.5). D20, D22, D_v23 and D_v24 are itemised in W.6, X.8 and Y.5 at counted prices. Sensitivities: P kept online 33.03813; D_v23 and D_v24 at 2^25 each 32.97809; B charged 33.1581; no repricing beyond v22b 33.0396; no repricing beyond v20 33.1055; D15 doubled 33.5293.
heuristics.limitations: Rule K was written after C, R5 and R6 had run, by an author who knew their outcomes; it counts as a priori only because it reads none of them and was hashed before R7 (W.1); a reader who rejects that premise should use the sensitivities above. Repricing development at the submitted programs' prices is the rule of v14, v15 and v17, applied again in v22, v23 and v24 (X.5, Y.4); a reader who rejects repricing beyond v22b gets 33.0396, or beyond v20 gets 33.1055. A reader who keeps P online gets 33.03813; a reader who also charges B gets 33.1581. A1 (v7's design study, 10,432 CPU-s) stays uncharged as in v13-v22; charged 40.9861. v17's B' re-derivations charged 33.9101. R7's plan would have fallen back to v19 on failure; a reader who charges R7 for that gets the R7 sensitivity above (W.3). D15's largest item is an upper bound (the stopped run is charged complete); D15 doubled 33.5293. D16 is v17's stated bound. B2's re-count, which would fix a number of the claim, was not run (X.7).
